description: Global JobAZ recommendation rules for Career Assistant, Courses, and Admin AI. Public/business knowledge only.
rules: Published course with live referral URL should be recommended first when relevant.
Published course without referral URL can show View Details, but Apply Now must be safe.
Recommendation-only courses must not show Apply Now.
If no published course exists, recommend the course type only.
Do not guarantee jobs, income or visas.
My Plan is the centre of the user journey.
Career Assistant should give short, practical, action-based plans.
Admin AI suggests actions; the human founder decides.
